exact_statement: For every finite nonempty graph prime table with both endpoint orders, pi=1/4 and a globally fixed positive feasible base vector, freezing its exact maximal-matching star actual-run posterior gives a convex complete log-weight objective with usage c_e computed by the multiaffine occupation mass derivative. Every c_e is positive; if the graph has at least two edges, sum c_e>Var f and the global positive minimizer is attained and unique. For one edge the complete frozen cost is weight-independent. Every rational proposed feasible vector admits an exact global gap certificate using coordinate prices and a rational mixture of its normalized nonempty root law with the singleton law c/sum c. The bit gap is bounded by twice the entirely rational root chi-square, incidence slack and edge square-error expression in WEIGHT_GAP.md. Exact independent certificates for all 63 nonempty four-vertex graph DNFs and five specified five-vertex graphs prove complete frozen cost<9I/2 and global frozen-posterior optimality gap<=I/10^7. No universal graph cost bound or jointly optimized PI-J lower bound is asserted.
hypotheses: uniform cube; arbitrary finite positive simple graph edge prime DNF on covered coordinates
both fixed endpoint orders per gate and rarity 1/4
strictly positive coordinate-incidence-feasible base vector; actual maximal-matching star posterior frozen before changing weights
full original conditioned queue, all subset/count/multiset/root/label factors retained; costs in bits
root-law mixture is dual certificate side information, not an output-dependent reference choice
finite cost domain exactly all 63 labelled nonempty n=4 edge tables plus n=5 cycle, path, star, clique and triangle with leaves at vertices 0,1

exact_statement: For every finite nonempty simple graph G with globally fixed both endpoint orders per width-two prime gate, pi=1/4, strictly positive feasible lambda, and D=product_e(1+lambda_e/4)-1, for every covered nonempty A and inclusion-maximal matching M of G[A], set U=A minus its matched vertices and m=|M|. Put P_M(z)=product_(u in U)[sum_(v outside A,uv edge)lambda_uv/32+sum_(v matched,uv edge)lambda_uv*z_v/8]. For monomial z^h define J_M(z^h)=product_(e={v,w} in M)h_v!h_w!/((c_e+1)^2(c_e+2)), c_e=h_v+h_w. The exact original conditioned maximal-matching star output mass is Q_M=D^-1 product_(e in M)(lambda_e/24) J_M(P_M). With independent per-matching-edge T uniform[0,1], B density 2(1-b), and independent rate-one exponentials Y_v,Y_w, J_M(P)=2^-m E P(X) for X_v=TB*Y_v and X_w=TB*Y_w. For all integers a,b>=0 and c=a+b, a!b!/((c+1)^2(c+2))>=(1/2)*6^-c*2^max(c-1,0). Consequently if P=sum_h p_h z^h, k(h)=sum_e c_e and d(h)=number of matching parents with c_e>0, Q_M>=D^-1 product_(e in M)(lambda_e/48) sum_h p_h*6^-k(h)*2^(k(h)-d(h)). This retains exact occupation multiplicities and a certified collision bonus beyond the discarded-factor row-sum bound, but asserts no universal influence payment or polynomial complexity.
hypotheses: uniform physical signs, arbitrary finite positive simple graph edge DNF
one globally fixed prime table, both endpoint orders, rarity pi=1/4 and positive feasible lambda before sampling A
A covered nonempty, M inclusion-maximal, unmatched U independent
original conditioned queue and actual chronological events; all size, subset, count, multiset, label and absent-root factors retained
integer monomial exponents, polynomial coefficients summed when neighbor choices produce identical occupation vectors
ideal output reference mass, no free physical prefix rounding or table selection
